newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: FCL Forests to sell forest - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: FCL Forests to sell forest - newspaper.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Forests is expected to complete the sale of its 20,000 hectare Hikurangi forest on the North Island's east coast before the year's end, the New Zealand Herald reported on Wednesday.
The Herald said a number of parties were interested in the forest, which is expected to fetch NZ$300 million.
FCL Forests plans to use the proceeds to pay for its 37.5 percent interst in Forestry Corp, as well as buy Tasman Lumber from the FCL Building division, the paper said.
The deadline for bids was believed to be November 14.
Interested parties could include Carter Holt Harvey Ltd, U.S.-owned Rayonier New Zealand, Juken Nissho of Japan, Eearnslaw One, which is owned by Malaysia's Tiong family, and Evergreen Forests.
The Herald also speculated that Boston-based Xylem Investments and Resource Investments may also be looking at Hikurangi. Xylem owns 60 percent of Evergreen.
